in_sanskrit.name: Sharvikaani
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharvikaani एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who is the Goddess of Prosperity, Wealth, and Fortune. She is the preserver of wealth and remover of poverty. She is also the Goddess of Fertility, and is worshipped for a good marriage and children.
